reason: First Gate 1 execution for NQ. Simplified design requested by Nico: a direct fork of the proven GC MFE-MAE all5 design (specs/bt2_absorption_gate1_all5_post_outcome_replication_2026-08-26.json), K_ABS-primary with K_BT2/N_RAND/K_ABS_SHUFFLE as comparators, no external BigTrap2 comparator sweep dependency (K_BT2 comes inline from the bigtrap2 module's own DEFAULTS, exactly as in GC). K_ABS uses the informal early-stop config bt2a_nq_7e84981882b0b380 (specs/bt2a_nq_selected_configuration_2026-08-29.json) instead of module DEFAULTS -- see docs/research/DECISION_NQ_SELECTION_EARLY_STOP_2026-08-29.md for why this config is informal (2 of 5 contracts, no formal structural_score) and not SELECTED_STABLE_NQ_CONFIGURATION.

universe.selection: all valid weekday sessions in fixed non-overlapping contract windows

K_ABS.parameters_note: Differs from bigtrap2absorption module DEFAULTS in exactly one field: MinStackedRows=1 instead of 2. Full 21-key parameter dict is hardcoded as K_ABS_PARAMS_NQ in edgelab/research/bt2_gate1_nq_all5.py to avoid an implicit dependency on module DEFAULTS remaining GC-shaped.

execution.fill: first canonical tick strictly after the signal
execution.memory_mode: one selected session plus immediately preceding valid session
execution.warmup: previous valid session reconstructs the rolling 500 x 25-tick absorption state; at the left edge, all available pre-sample ticks are used
execution.memory_bound: never loads a complete multi-month contract into RAM
execution.checkpoint_invalidation: sample registry hash + input registry hash + runtime hash

power.interpretation: Larger N improves precision but cannot restore the confirmatory firewall after outcomes were opened. Session-count threshold (133) is inherited unchanged from the GC design this spec forks -- it is a property of the shared estimand/method, not a re-derived NQ-specific power computation; no MDE/ICC analysis was run for NQ.

firewall.PREEXISTING_OUTCOME_EXPOSURE_NOTE: NQ's known prior exposure is the BigTrap2 comparator sweep that touched the holdout (future_price_path_accessed=true, first_touch_accessed=true, holdout_touched=true) but never accessed MFE/MAE or PnL -- the estimand this Gate 1 measures. This run is the first NQ MFE-MAE measurement. edgelab/research/bt2_gate1_nq_all5.py computes this label dynamically from that classification file at result-build time rather than hardcoding it.

interpretation_contract.allowed_claim: evidence of a contrast against the specified null within this post-outcome sample
forbidden_claims: not luck or noise in general
interpretation_contract.secondary_controls: A 95% interval containing zero fails the declared comparison even if nearly all of it is positive.
